summary: Tested 3 new features: closures with fixed numbers (+ /closure/preview), /api/performance and bet cost, plus a quick regression. Backend: 87/87 pytest pass (-n 0). This includes a new test_fixed_perf.py that checks the 14/13/15 guarantees by brute force when fixed numbers are used, checks the 422 validations, checks that preview does not save, and checks the /performance numbers by hand against the 301 upload. Frontend: closure modal (cycle none->selected->fixed->none, fixas count, debounced estimate, cost, backend error for full mode with 19 numbers, Fixas summary), costs (default 3.5, saved in localStorage after reload, generator/generated/batch costs update live, BRL format), performance (empty -> table + winner after uploading 301 through the UI), generator, auto check, Atraso tab and TXT/XLS exports all work. DB restored to 300 contests (#1-#300) and the original 13 batches.

minor.issue: Runs one find_contest query per batch (N+1 pattern) and loads at most 1000 batches. Fine at current size.
Overall rows are averaged per game, so one big closure (e.g. 481 games) dominates 'Fechamento (geral)' and decides the winner. Consider also showing a per-batch average.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid input (empty, 0, -1) is silently ignored: the input shows '-1' while costs keep using the last valid price, with no error or reset on blur.
Clicking an unselected number when 20 are already chosen does nothing and shows no feedback.

issues: The title 'Desempenho do gerador' covers both generator and closure; something like 'Desempenho: gerador x fechamento' would be clearer.

action_items: Optional: validate or reset input-bet-price on blur when the value is <= 0
Optional: ignore stale preview responses in ClosureDialog (no cancel flag; an earlier slow response could overwrite a newer one)
Optional: test_lotofacil_api.py (~line 134-147, the /generate window/quantity tests) leaves 3 batches behind on every run. Track them and delete them in teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: closure_games: covering over the free numbers with k = len(numbers)-15 is correct; brute force confirms the guarantee for every case tested
ClosureIn's 816 limit for full mode uses comb(n - fixed, n - 15), which matches the real count (19 numbers with 5 fixed = 1001 rejected; 6 fixed = 715 allowed)
ClosureDialog useEffect preview has no abort or stale guard (race condition)
Cost.jsx usePrice does not listen to the 'storage' event, so a price change does not sync across tabs (minor)
seed_data_creation: None kept. Uploaded 301 temporarily, then cleared and re-uploaded lotofacil_exemplo.txt (300 contests). Deleted the batches created by tests and the UI; 13 batches remain, as before.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. test_fixed_perf.py::test_performance_manual uploads 301 and restores the 300 contests in a finally block; it requires that no batch has last_concurso=301 and that the DB has #1-#300. test_lotofacil_api.py leaves 3 batches per run. Testids: input-bet-price, generator-cost, generated-cost, batch-cost-i, closure-cost, closure-count, closure-estimate, closure-error, performance-section/empty/winner, table-performance. closure-number-N has data-state none|selected|fixed.
